title: Find north
introduction: Use an absolute direction to select the correct branch of an intersection.
explanation: ! negates a condition: !facingNorth() is true whenever Karel is not facing north. Combined with while, it can turn an unknown starting direction into a known one.
objective: Face north, follow the northern branch, and place the coin at (3, 5). Finish there facing north with an empty bag.
instruction: The initial direction varies across all four compass directions. Use ! with facingNorth().

commands.description: True exactly when Karel faces north.
True when Karel faces any other direction.

hints: Rotate until the desired direction is reached.
When already facing north, the turning loop must execute zero times.
Use while (!facingNorth()) with turnLeft();, then walk to the wall and place the coin.

illustration.alt: The compass gives an absolute heading. Keep turning while not facing north, then follow the northern branch.
illustration.caption: The compass gives an absolute heading. Keep turning while not facing north, then follow the northern branch.
